notes.title: Dagger Run: Aerocombatic Racing Kickstarter is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44746451/18c2b571c194f25c540da177e90a7a550f96f6bb.png[/img]

Hi Everyone. It's with a fair measure of nervous excitement that I am please to announce the launch of my Kickstarter campaign for Dagger Run: Aerocombatic Racing!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/stardaze-interactive/dagger-run-aerocombatic-racing]Click here to visit the campaign[/url]

First of all I just wanted to thank all of you who have wishlisted the game so far, it has meant a lot to me to be able to see your support. 
If you are interested in seeing more of the game and you would like to help me continue the development of it please consider heading over to the Kickstarter page and donating some money. There are some cool rewards that you can pick up along the way.

With thanks,
Korda
Stardaze Interactive
